reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing link.assertAccountIsNotLinked pattern with a sibling link.assertAccountIsOpen and calls it from every provider link function.

duplication.why: The rule and message exist once; the only repetition is the six identical `if (upgradingId)` guards around the call, which the helper could have absorbed.

placement.why: The check sits in accounts/link.ts beside the other link preconditions, and runs before any write in each link function.

scope.why: Only the new check, its six calls and unit tests.

maintainability.why: A clear single precondition; a new provider must remember to call it, as with the existing duplicate-link check, and the upgradingId guard is repeated at each site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link functions call link.assertAccountIsOpen.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the closed-account rule is defined only in link.assertAccountIsOpen.

one_place.where: link.assertAccountIsOpen in accounts/link.ts holds the rule; every provider link path (GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Fintegra, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Enable Banking) calls it.
